text.description_html:
Brass Accents A05-P5350, 11-1/4" Arts and Crafts Push Plate

With the textured plate and square cut-outs, the Arts and Crafts Push Plate has a rustic look. It is available in a wide array of finishes including the ever popular polished brass, satin nickel, and venetian bronze. The indents on the plate helps to bring out the highlights of each of the available finishes. This push plate measures 11-1/4 inches high and 2-7/8 inches wide, making it an impressive statement on any door.

Also Available: Arts and Crafts Pull Plate

Specifications for Arts and Crafts Decorative Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 2-7/8"
  • Plate Height: 11-1/4"
  • Material: Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
